title: Ginger Lentil and Sweet Potato Stew
steps: Dice the onion, carrot, and celery. Peel and cube the sweet potato. Mince the garlic and ginger.
Warm the olive oil in a large pot and soften the onion, carrot, and celery for 8 minutes.
Stir in the garlic, ginger, turmeric, cumin, and black pepper and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the lentils, sweet potato, and broth. Simmer for 30 minutes, until the lentils are tender.
Stir the chopped kale through and cook 3 more minutes. Finish with lemon juice.
storageNotes: Refrigerate up to 4 days, or freeze up to 3 months. Reheat on the stove over medium-low heat, adding a splash of water since the lentils keep thickening. Add a fresh squeeze of lemon after reheating.
goldenRuleCallouts: Broth is the usual hidden trap in a stew: use a certified gluten-free carton, or make it from scratch.
Turmeric, ginger, and garlic all appear here in cooking amounts rather than as a garnish.
Lentils and kale carry the fiber load that feeds the gut microbiome.
